newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends firmer as LME spreads strengthen.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends firmer as LME spreads strengthen.

text.p: COMEX copper settled firmer as the market continued to rebound, dominated by tightness in LME's January contract and a doubling of London's cash premium over three months since earlier in the week, traders said.
"We have a good solid market and you don't have to look any further than the spreads," futures strategist William O'Neill of Merrill Lynch said.
The LME backwardation was $100 to $104 at close of trade on COMEX.

"The tightness in January will continue to underpin the market through the first week of January. There is more to come on the upside in the short-term," O'Neill said, adding that he expected a 4,000 to 5,000-tonne hike in LME stocks Friday.
March COMEX settled 1.70 cents firmer at 100.30 cents per pound, traded 100.55 to 98.50 cents. Spot December went out 2.225 cents higher at 103.30 cents.
